text: Mobile app development is an exciting field today. Developers must consider responsive design so apps work well on different screen sizes. They also choose between native and cross-platform approaches. Native apps are built for one platform, while cross-platform apps run on several. Each choice affects performance, speed, and user experience. After development, apps are published on app stores like Google Play or the App Store. Performance matters a lot because users expect fast, smooth apps. Good planning helps developers create useful applications that people enjoy using every day.
